name: Black Bean, Bell Pepper & Quinoa Bowl with Peach Salsa & Feta

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: In a small saucepan, combine the quinoa, salt, and water; bring to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups quinoa
¾ tsp salt
3 cups water

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 green bell peppers
6 peaches
1 ½ limes
1 ½ small bunches cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse the beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the quinoa for 15 minutes. Once done, remove the quinoa from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Quarter the bell peppers lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Small dice the peppers and transfer to a large bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

While the skillet heats up, trim off and discard the ends of the onions and remove the outer layer; small dice the onions (cut into ¼-inch pieces). Add half of the onion to the bowl with the peppers and the other half to a separate medium bowl that will hold the salsa.
Once the skillet is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add the onion and bell peppers to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables have softened, 4 to 6 minutes.
While the vegetables cook, quarter the peaches lengthwise (around the pit) and twist the quarters to separate, then remove and discard the pit; small dice the quarters and add to the salsa bowl.
Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add to the salsa bowl.
Add the beans to the skillet and season with chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper; cook until the mixture is heated through and well combined, 1 to 2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tsp chili powder
1 ½ tsp cumin
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Juice the limes and add to the salsa bowl.
Season the salsa with salt and pepper; toss to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place the feta in a small bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: Uncover the quinoa and fluff with a fork.
To serve, divide the quinoa between bowls, top with the bean mixture and peach salsa, and sprinkle with the feta. Enjoy!
